einzeiler: Alistair Begg examines the biblical call for husbands to love their wives.
kurzfassung: Alistair Begg explores the biblical instruction for husbands to love their wives through self-sacrifice and spiritual devotion. He explains that earthly marriage serves to reflect the ultimate union between Christ and the church. Husbands are called to renounce neglect and abuse while looking to the cross as their primary model for love.
stichpunkte: Christian marriage points beyond itself to the divine union of Christ and the church.
A husband's primary objective is preparing his wife to meet Jesus.
Biblical love, or agape, requires self-sacrifice and giving rather than receiving.
Husbands must actively renounce physical, emotional, and spiritual neglect.
Partners must eliminate all forms of abuse, including belittling and condescension.
Avoiding complacency prevents taking the marriage relationship for granted.
The cross-shaped love of Jesus provides the ultimate standard and motivation.
Fulfilling this high calling requires ongoing prayer for the guidance of the Holy Spirit.
